PlayFDroid Open-Source Games

Classic open-source Android games and modern ports revived for Android 14/15/16+ (64-bit ARMv9).

Currently it serves 8 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PlayFDroid/fdroid-repo/gh-pages/fdroid/repo
